guidance.heading: Updated 2026 Outlook
section: WaterBridge is updating its full-year 2026 guidance across three key metrics. Due to produced water handling volumes exceeding expectations across the Company's Delaware Basin footprint, produced water handling volumes are now expected in the range of 2.65 to 2.75 million Bbl/d and Adjusted EBITDA guidance is now expected in the range of $465 to $485 million, which represent increases of 2% and 4% at the midpoint of the ranges, respectively. Due to timing expectations of capital outlay for projects shifting from 2026 into 2027, capital expenditures guidance has narrowed to a range of $530 to $560 million, a decrease of 3% at the midpoint of the range.
